title: THE SCAR
logSummary: A second Plumb over Ninewalls, a herd for cover, and a Screed walking on the crescent walls.

stages.note: Take the road up into the Crescent Holds
stages.log: Walked the switchback up from the Pans into the Holds.

stages.note: Reach the Plumb above Ninewalls in the herd's lee
stages.log: Walked up the slope in the Tillers' lee.

stages.note: Topple the Plumb on the terrace
stages.log: Toppled the Plumb on the terrace.

stages.note: Make Barbed arrows from the Peg pins
stages.log: Made Barbed arrows from the Peg pins.

stages.note: Find Oro at the tube mouth
stages.log: Oro gave the gaff, the Windwall and three pots.

stages.note: Lure the Screed's charge into a wall
stages.log: The Screed ran its blade into a wall and stood.
stages.logBranch: The Screed cut the third wall down to the line.

stages.note: Break a ram seal: Brine it, then rip it

stages.log: Both ram seals off. The blade is down.

closing.logEnd: The Screed stood down. The line is still on four walls.
closing.logEndBranch: The third wall is cut to the line. Ninewalls is poorer, and standing.

scenes.where: the tube mouth, the forge banked

lines: Saltrow's Reckoner. I watched you
put the painter on its back
from the forge door.
Two hits on the vial and four
seconds down. It'll be up by now.
It's not the one I'd watch.
Look at the outer walls.
A Screed. Three point eight metres
of it, cutting down to the line.
How long before it's at the houses?
The third wall by noon, at that pace.
You won't stop it with a bow
and a shepherd's stick.
Boat gaff. Pine Windwall, nine slats.
Two Brine and one Cinder.
Brine goes on the rams.
Brine seizes the seal, the gaff
rips it off. Two seals, two rips.
And it can't turn once it's running.
Stand in front of a wall
and step out of its way.
Let the stone take the blade.
The walls were built for something.

scenes.where: under the third wall, after the fight

lines: Down, and both rams dry.
My grandfather built that wall.
It will send another.
It is not angry.
The wall is not on its map.
Then its map is out by nine walls.
Benchmark 1 is seventy metres
down the Scar.
The old bronze stud? The cutters
ran straight over it.
Fifteen seconds on the Alidade
and three bearings, and Ninewalls
is true ground.
Then go and make it true.
I'll keep the forge lit.

breaAlone.about: Brea's own turns in the field on 'The Scar': one card each, shown as a subtitle when its trigger first happens. Each trigger shows once.

lines: Saltrow to Ninewalls: 256 metres
of road and sixty of climb.
The Holds. Black ash to the ridge,
and Ninewalls under it. Nine walls.
Tillers, five in file, coring
up the slope on one bearing.
The Plumb is on the terrace above.
Four and a half metres of hull each,
and none of them turns.
Walk where they walk.
In the lee. The Plumb can't see
through two metres of enamel.
Down for four seconds.
Long enough to see what it painted.
Six Barbed, off Peg pins.
They'll bite in a seal.
Something big is on the outer walls.
The smith will know what.
Twenty-five metres of charge,
and it can't turn once it's going.
Put a wall behind me.
Into the stone. Three seconds
before it backs off.
One seal off. One left.
Three walls down to the line.
Not the houses. Not yet.
